WeChat article cover image, subject: 戈壁上唱完图兰朵，凯迪拉克反手掏出一台25.99万的混动SUV — 贺兰山脚下，骏马踏过戈壁，歌剧《图兰朵》的最后一个音符还没散尽。凯迪拉克把这场秋季艺术大赏选在这里，不是没有道理——荒原、远山、砂石路，恰好是XT5最熟悉的戏码。

全新XT5 PHEV就在这种氛围里上市了。两款车型，限时权益价25.99万到27.99万，加上最高8万的购车礼包。但我今天不想念参数表，我想聊的是另一件事：凯迪拉克在这台车上做了一个决定——全系标配。

混动时代的豪华，到底应该怎么定. Clean minimalist business cover, solid or subtle gradient background, lots of white space, bold modern Chinese typography as the visual focus, no decorative elements, professional and elegant, editorial magazine style. CRITICAL RULES: Do NOT include any text, letters, Chinese characters, or watermarks in the image. Do NOT generate overly smooth, plastic-like, or hyper-saturated AI-art style. Aim for photorealistic or high-quality editorial illustration style. Natural lighting, natural textures, subtle imperfections are preferred. Avoid shiny/glossy effects. Avoid rainbow gradients. Avoid 3D rendered look. The image should look like it was taken by a professional photographer or designed by a human graphic designer.
